def load_model(base_model_path, adapter_path, device):
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(base_model_path, trust_remote_code=True)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        base_model_path, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map=device, trust_remote_code=True
    )
    if adapter_path:
        model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(model, adapter_path)
    model.eval()
    return model, tokenizer

def benchmark_cls(model, tokenizer, samples, max_seq_length=2048, device="cuda:0"):
    """CLS: single forward pass, read logits for pass/fail."""
    times = []
    for sample in samples:
        # Format input same as eval
        text = f"<|im_start|>system\nYou are a code verifier.<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>user\n{sample['code']}\n{sample['test']}<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n"
        inputs = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=max_seq_length).to(device)
        
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        start = time.perf_counter()
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = model(**inputs)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
        times.append(elapsed)
    return times

def benchmark_cwm(model, tokenizer, samples, max_seq_length=2048, max_new_tokens=512, device="cuda:0"):
    """CWM: autoregressive generation."""
    times = []
    output_lengths = []
    for sample in samples:
        text = f"<|im_start|>system\nPredict execution output.<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>user\n{sample['code']}\n{sample['test']}<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n"
        inputs = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=max_seq_length).to(device)
        
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        start = time.perf_counter()
        with torch.no_grad():
            out = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, do_sample=False)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
        
        gen_len = out.shape[1] - inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]
        times.append(elapsed)
        output_lengths.append(gen_len)
    return times, output_lengths
